title: Escondidinho
description: Escondidinho is a dish from Brazil featuring cassava root, whole cow milk, ground beef, yellow onion. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 27 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Drain the cooked ingredients and pound or mash while warm for about 9 minutes until thick, elastic and smooth; shape into portions with wet hands or a spoon.
Combine the remaining ingredients, cover partly and stew gently for about 22 minutes until the flavors meld and everything is tender.
Layer the previously prepared components evenly inside a baking dish, serving mold or plate appropriate to the recipe; smooth the surface and avoid mixing the layers.
Bake the shaped or assembled mixture in a preheated oven for about 25 minutes until set and cooked through.
